Kill switch and lockdown: in the phone\'s VPN settings, tap the gear next to PiGuard and switch on always-on VPN and blocking connections without VPN. Android then blocks everything that would go past the tunnel.

If you did not press Cancel, another VPN app is probably set to always-on, for example WireGuard. Android then refuses every other VPN. Open the VPN settings, tap the gear next to that app, turn off always-on, and try again.
